title: Explainable Machine Learning for Multilayer Planar Winding Inductance Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2609.37211v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Rapid and accurate self-inductance estimation for multilayer rectangle-shaped planar windings is essential for modern high-frequency power converters, yet traditional workflows rely on complex mathematical equations, rigid monomial formulas or unexplainable black-box machine learning (ML) models that degrade severely outside their training domain. This paper introduces an explainable ML framework unifying post-hoc feature attribution (SHAP and permutation importance) with Kolmogorov-Arnold Network-guided symbolic regression via the SR-KAN framework to discover closed-form analytical equations without prior structural assumptions. Evaluated on a new open-source dataset of over 10,000 Finite Element Analysis (FEA) simulations across seven out-of-distribution (OOD) classes, standard tree-based ensembles exhibit severe extrapolation errors (> 36%), whereas the unconstrained SR-KAN expression achieves a robust OOD relative error of 8.22%. translated_title: 用于多层平面绕组电感估计的可解释机器学习
translated_abstract: 对多层矩形平面绕组进行快速且准确的自感估计对于现代高频功率变换器至关重要，然而传统工作流程依赖于复杂的数学方程、僵化的单项式公式或不可解释的黑盒机器学习（ML）模型，这些模型在训练域之外性能会严重退化。本文提出了一种可解释的机器学习框架，将事后特征归因方法（SHAP和置换重要性）与通过SR-KAN框架实现的Kolmogorov-Arnold网络引导的符号回归相结合，在无需先验结构假设的情况下发现闭合形式的解析方程。在一个包含超过10,000次有限元分析（FEA）仿真、涵盖七类分布外（OOD）数据的新型开源数据集上进行评估，标准的树模型集成表现出严重的外推误差（>36%），而无约束的SR-KAN表达式实现了8.22%的稳健OOD相对误差。
tldr: 本文提出一种结合SHAP特征归因与KAN引导符号回归（SR-KAN）的可解释机器学习框架，能够自动发现闭合解析公式，在分布外数据上以8.22%的相对误差准确估计多层平面绕组电感，显著优于传统黑盒模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an explainable ML framework (SR-KAN) that unifies SHAP feature attribution with Kolmogorov-Arnold Network-guided symbolic regression, discovering closed-form analytical equations that estimate multilayer planar winding inductance with a robust 8.22% out-of-distribution relative error, far outperforming black-box models.
